# Draft:War Photographer

War Photographer is a poem written by Carol Ann Duffy(b.1955, Poet Laureate May 2009-2019) in 1985. It was added to the GCSE(formerly known as 'O-Levels') poem 'Power and Conflict' anthology in 2015(first examination that used it was 2017), and is examined in the AQA GCSE English Literature Paper 2, Section B. It relates to the experience of Don McCullin, one of Duffy's acquaintances, and the dilemma faced by war photographers for whether they should continue taking photos or help those whom they portray in their images. There is a sense of futility throughout the poem, emphasised through juxtapositions and the blunt, bathotic ending of "and they do not care."
